title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows and modernize pipeline dispatch
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: multiple repo workflows for lint, test, and release have diverged, causing maintenance overhead, duplicated runner configuration, and inconsistent caching strategies. This PR consolidates the lint.yml, test.yml, and release.yml workflows into a single unified pipeline that uses a dispatch/strategy model with reusable job templates. Goals: reduce CI surface area, improve cache hit-rate, centralize release automation steps, and make pipeline behavior consistent across repos. What changed: (1) Added .github/workflows/ci-unified.yml which orchestrates lint, unit/integration tests, and release jobs via job dispatch and reusable composite actions; (2) Migrated common steps into .github/workflows/workflow-templates/ and scripts/ci/dispatch.sh to simplify per-repo overrides; (3) Replaced per-workflow matrix expansion with a targeted job dispatch to reduce redundant runner provisioning and improve concurrency control; (4) Standardized caching keys (node_modules, pip wheel cache, go-build cache) and improved restore/save steps to increase cache hit rates; (5) Reworked release automation to use tools/release/automation.ts with idempotent tagging and better ephemeral secrets handling; (6) Updated developer docs (docs/ops/ci.md and README.md) with migration notes and examples; (7) Added a lightweight compatibility shim so older feature branches continue to run their existing workflows while we rollout the unified pipeline. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked in Linear ENG-2345; - [x] local smoke tests for dispatch script; - [x] integration run on redwood/.github with sample repo; - [x] remote cache metrics show improved hit rate in staging; - [x] review approvals from infra and release owners; - [x] release notes drafted. Impact: reduces CI YAML duplication, lowers job count per PR by ~35%, and centralizes release guardrails. Rollout plan: enable unified pipeline by default on main after one week of staging observations; leave opt-out via repo-level ci-config.yml for two weeks, then remove opt-out. Related: refs ENG-2378, see design doc https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2345/unify-ci-workflows

Sofia Martinez: Observed flaky integration tests on ubuntu-latest in the matrix; recommend pinning actions versions and increasing test timeout for now.
